item.title: SHAFT 0.87.0
item.description:
SHAFT on a Mac without admin rights: Listen and migration (#58, #59); voice stream tests and gate output (#55).

  • shaft listen on sets Listen up itself: .venv-listen with the app's uv and Python, pinned engines and an ffmpeg of its own (imageio-ffmpeg); one ffmpeg resolver for the worker and speaker clips. A recording uploaded where Listen is not set up (no environment, job or HF_TOKEN) is kept, marked failed with the reason and pushed; listen on queues it again.
  • shaft migrate moves an app install between non-admin Macs: the .runtime Python and uv, local-only api/web restored with --local, no Tailscale requirement then, sleep setting optional; Listen stopped and restarted, .venv-listen rebuilt.
  • Voice stream tests wait on the reply's push; the gate keeps every failure's assertion ahead of the output tail.
